newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index slightly lower, volume up.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index slightly lower, volume up.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index closed slightly lower on Tuesday but volume was higher, bourse sources said.
The 30-share index closed at 549.43, barely down from 549.86 on Monday.
Volume was 1.27 million dinars against 283,031 dinars.
Coke bottler SFBT rose 2.6 dinars to 89.9 dinars. BDET bank was up 0.4 dinar to 17.1.
Retail stores Monoprix fell 1.02 dinars to 32.96. BIAT bank eased 0.4 dinar to 33.1.
Most of the trade was in Banque Nationale Agricole with 31,000 shares changing hands at the unchanged price of 31 dinars.
